Released: 29 September 2026

New features, enhancements, bug fixes, and security fixes in Postgres Enterprise Manager 10.6.0 include the following:

## Highlights

- Support for RHEL 10 and Debian 13
- New **Job Templates** to create reusable job definitions
- Improved self-monitoring capabilities via the new **Probe Diagnostics** feature
- Monitor log errors and autovacuum with new built-in probes and alerts

## Enhancements

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Introduced Job Templates for agent-agnostic, reusable job definitions
that can fan out to multiple targets.
</summary><p>Job Templates let a single job definition run across many agents instead
of requiring a separate job per target. Import and export of Job
Templates is also supported.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>Added the Probe Diagnostics UI for per-probe health and performance
investigation.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Introduced end-to-end password-in-transit encryption.
</summary><p>Browser-to-server credentials are now encrypted with RSA-OAEP: the server
generates per-session RSA keypairs and the client uses the Web Crypto
API, with un-decryptable ciphertext rejected as a bad request.
Feature-gated via <code>PEM_ENCRYPT_PASSWORDS_IN_TRANSIT</code>, with an optional <code>PEM_REQUIRE_TRANSIT_ENCRYPTION</code> strict-enforcement mode. Operators can
also supply a custom encryption key for the ASB password store, replacing
the previously fixed key with an operator-controlled one.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added threshold-aware autovacuum and autoanalyze overdue alerts.
</summary><p>Both alerts now consider per-table size rather than raw time-since-last-run,
so noisy small tables no longer generate false positives while large
tables with a genuine backlog surface promptly.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added the <code>server_log_severity_scan</code> probe for near-real-time
PANIC/FATAL/ERROR log alerting.
</summary><p>A format-aware log parser scans server log files continuously, detects
and cleanly recovers from log rotation, and stores events in <code>pemdata.server_log_severity_scan</code>. Timestamp comparison is
DateStyle-aware so both PostgreSQL and EPAS work correctly.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added <code>pem_advisor</code>, a standalone CLI tuning tool for the PEM backend
database.
</summary><p>The tool connects read-only and analyzes memory, connections, WAL and
checkpoints, autovacuum, planner settings, logging, background writer,
JIT, and replication settings, producing a tiered terminal report as well
as markdown, SQL, and JSON output. It is compatible with PostgreSQL 17
and EPAS, and is installed at <code>/usr/edb/pem/maintenance_tool/bin/pem_advisor</code>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added the ability to email scheduled reports over SMTP.
</summary><p>Scheduled reports can now be sent as HTML or JSON file attachments over
SMTP, with the report rendered entirely in the database.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added Kerberos service-ticket authentication mode.
</summary><p>The PEM web tier can now maintain a single shared credential cache from a
service keytab and connect to the PEM backend as a service principal,
while PostgreSQL maps the SPN to a database role via <code>pg_ident.conf</code> and
the DSN carries the end user in the <code>user=</code> field. Three new
configuration keys — <code>PEM_KRB_USE_SERVICE_TICKET</code>, <code>PEM_KRB_SERVICE_CACHE_NAME</code>, and <code>PEM_USER_KRB_INCLUDE_REALM</code> — control
the behaviour.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added monitoring support for PostgreSQL 19 and EPAS 19.
</summary><p>The probe and alert template surface has been updated to cover the new
server version.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added support for custom, user-managed encryption keys for Agent Server
Binding (ASB) passwords.
</summary><p>Encryption keys can now be supplied via <code>PEM_ENC_FILE</code> or <code>PEM_ENC_SCRIPT</code>, enabling key rotation via a key index embedded in the
encrypted payload.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added a recurring system job to purge data belonging to deleted agents,
servers, and Barman tools.
</summary><p>The &quot;Purge deleted objects&quot; job runs every 15 minutes and re-evaluates
the <code>deleted_objects_data_retention_time</code> setting on each run, so
changing the retention threshold also affects entities already awaiting
purge. Children are drained in bounded batches before the parent row is
removed, and cleanup covers both the <code>pem</code> catalog schema and the <code>pemdata</code> / <code>pemhistory</code> schemas.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added support for Debian 13 (Trixie) as a customer runtime platform.
</summary><p>New runtime requirements files ship for <code>debian-13-amd64</code> and <code>debian-13-arm64</code>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>Bundled HTTPD 2.4.68 with the PEM installer for Windows.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Added support for RHEL 10 on arm64, ppc64le, and s390x platforms.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Enhanced the agent watchdog subsystem for improved process resilience
and observability.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added threshold ordering validation to the Profile PUT API.
</summary><p>The endpoint now rejects mis-ordered thresholds (ascending required for
the <code>&gt;</code> operator, descending for <code>&lt;</code>) on both newly added and modified
alert configurations, catching mis-configurations at write time instead
of at alert dispatch time.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>Improved the performance of the Grid View in dialogues.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Duplicate webhook name validation now runs on Add rather than only on
Save, so the user is warned earlier in the flow.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Custom probes can now carry a user-specified internal name.
</summary><p>The create dialog adds an &quot;Internal name&quot; field that auto-populates as <code>cp_</code> plus a slug and is editable during creation (read-only
afterwards). The <code>cp_</code> prefix is mandatory and the remainder must match <code>[a-z0-9_]+</code>.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Users holding the <strong>Scheduled Tasks</strong> role can now see and manage jobs on
their own agents.
</summary><p>System jobs remain admin-only, and schedule exceptions (skip dates) are
covered by the same scope.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>Added a portable way to check whether IPv6 is enabled.</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added indexes on <code>pem.probe_target_view</code> to improve performance.
</summary><p>New indexes on the <code>agent_id</code> and <code>probe_internal_name</code> columns speed up
probe-target lookups.</p>
</details></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Security Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed CVE-2026-86861, a symlink time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU)
vulnerability in the File Manager.
</summary><p>Closed a race window in <code>save_file</code> that could allow a leaf symlink to
redirect a save operation to an unintended path.</p>
</details></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed CVE-2026-86864, a vulnerability whereby the backup database was
not passed via <code>PGDATABASE</code>.</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed CVE-2026-86862, a vulnerability whereby the restore/maintenance
database was not passed via <code>PGDATABASE</code>.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Changes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Hardcoded both the agent heartbeat and server heartbeat intervals to 15
seconds for consistency.
</summary><p>This removes the previous mismatch where the two intervals could drift
apart under configuration overrides. You can still configure the heartbeat
tolerance as in previous versions, but this now affect only the tolerance
and not the underlying heartbeat intervals.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Removed the 24-hour cap on scheduled alert blackout duration.
</summary><p>The REST API v17 endpoint now accepts any positive integer number of
hours; the legacy endpoint still accepts the &quot;N hour(s)&quot; string form; and
the UI field validates a minimum of 1. Operators can now schedule
multi-day maintenance windows in a single blackout.</p>
</details></td><td>62855</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Hardened the Content Security Policy with per-request nonces.
</summary><p>The default policy no longer includes <code>'unsafe-inline'</code> or <code>'unsafe-eval'</code>. Every inline script and style across base templates and
tool-specific templates (Profiler, Dashboards, Cluster Topology, Reports,
REST API docs, Barman) is now tagged with a per-request nonce. <code>style-src</code> retains <code>'unsafe-inline'</code> to accommodate MUI runtime styles; <code>'unsafe-eval'</code> is added only in DEBUG builds.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Bug Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Applied the Object Explorer tag filter to agent nodes.
</summary><p>Tag-based filtering now behaves consistently across all node types.
Previously agents were skipped by the filter and remained visible
regardless of the selected tags.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed an issue whereby customer-customised system-job schedules, <code>jobenabled</code> flags, and step code could be silently overwritten across
reseed events.</td><td>61176</td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed an issue whereby an upgrade left a stale <code>pem.jobstep</code> row
referencing the dropped function <code>pem.purge_obsolete_data()</code>, causing
recurring job failures post-upgrade.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Corrected the display of alert timestamps under non-UTC session
settings.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby a changed agent working directory could break
subsequent operations because <code>agent_ssl_key</code> and <code>agent_ssl_cert</code> were
stored as relative rather than absolute paths.
</summary><p>These values are now converted to absolute paths during agent
registration.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Prevented duplicate <code>server_group</code> rows from being created when
multiple agents register concurrently against the same server group.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Scoped the PGD raft leader-id alert per node group.
</summary><p>PGD 5 raft subgroups elect leaders independently, so the alert now
includes <code>node_group_name</code> in the probe key columns, the data and
history tables, the chart, and the alert template.</p>
</details></td><td>63967</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a crash in the Performance Diagnostics Query Dashboard that fired
when a collected sample had no matching active session.
</summary><p>The wait-events timeline drill-down is also hardened against similar
null cases.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Resolved dashboard tab titles on the backend so remotely monitored
servers open the correct dashboard tab.
</summary><p>Previously the tab could resolve to the wrong monitored server.</p>
</details></td><td>64640</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed the Database cleanup upgrade script to use <code>CALL</code> instead of <code>SELECT</code> for stored-procedure invocations, matching the
procedure-vs-function change for <code>pem.purge_probe_history</code>.
</summary><p>A subsequent update fixes any already-upgraded systems whose steps were
left using <code>SELECT</code>.</p>
</details></td><td>65129</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a schedule with only a start date so it runs once at the specified
time instead of firing every two minutes.
</summary><p>Empty pattern arrays are no longer implicitly treated as wildcards.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby agents could open two heartbeat connections (and
two main-thread connections) instead of one.
</summary><p>The heartbeat thread now waits for the old thread to exit before
recreating it, so two threads holding separate connections can no
longer coexist.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed an issue whereby agent registration could hang or fail with a lock
timeout while the probe target materialized view was refreshing on
large fleets.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed an issue whereby the Available Metric tree in Manage Charts (Line
Charts) did not populate or allow selection, blocking metric selection
for line-chart configurations.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Silenced a benign <code>SAWarning</code> surfaced during EPAS schema reflection in
Alembic migrations.
</summary><p>The warning was harmless but polluted upgrade logs.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby empty agent, database, schema, or object name
fields in SNMP trap generation produced &quot;value(s) do not match OID(s)&quot;
errors at the notification receiver.
</summary><p>An empty field previously collapsed the varbinding; a NULL placeholder
is now substituted instead.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Disabled editing of the Alternate Code tab for system probes in the UI.
</summary><p>The backend already silently rejected such edits; the SQL editor is now
read-only for system probes so the UI affordance matches the actual
permission.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the column misalignment in the Grid View when column groups are
present.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby special characters (backslash, newline, carriage
return, tab, and other control characters) in webhook payload values
could produce invalid JSON and cause the webhook target to reject the
payload.
</summary><p>These characters are now correctly escaped when substituted into
webhook payloads.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>The REST API token endpoint now returns HTTP 403 with an actionable
&quot;GRANT <code>pem_rest_api</code> to ...&quot; message when the caller is missing the
required role, instead of a misleading HTTP 401.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the Validate Binary Path modal so it renders its message as HTML
instead of showing the raw markup to the user.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed the Alert History Report selection semantics.
</summary><p>Choosing <strong>Global + servers/agents</strong> now returns all matching alerts
(previously only global alerts were returned); a <strong>Global</strong> selection no
longer overrides other selections; <strong>Cleared</strong> alerts are preserved in the

</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed duplicate and unfiltered Alert Template options in the Profile
dialog dropdown.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a crash on the Custom Dashboard page when a chart without a
description was added.
</summary><p>The missing description now renders safely instead of aborting the page
load.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Limited the markdown syntax accepted in chart descriptions so free-form
markdown cannot break the rendering pipeline or introduce style bleed
into the surrounding UI.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>The Manage Charts table now auto-refreshes when a new custom chart is
created, so the newly-created chart appears without requiring a manual
reload.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed empty chart description tooltips for custom charts added to
Custom Dashboards.
</summary><p>The tooltip now shows the chart's description text.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Chart description tooltips in the Custom Dashboard editor can now be
hovered and scrolled, allowing users to read long descriptions in full.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Inherited table columns are now correctly read-only and non-removable

</summary><p>The hardcoded OID and Definition-tab type restriction were removed and
replaced with proper checks on both the <code>inheritedfrom</code> and <code>inheritedfromtable</code> gates. Foreign-table inline <code>edit_types</code> filtering
is also fixed, along with readonly checks for <code>attstattarget</code> and <code>attstorage</code>. An ERD regression caused by the same issue was also

the user's session timezone.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed the Manage Profiles grid not extending to the panel bottom, and
the error toast overlapping data rows.</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby non-2xx webhook responses were silently marked as
a successful delivery.
</summary><p>HTTP error response handling for webhook payloads now correctly reports
non-2xx responses as failures.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed login for Kerberos users whose email in the PEM directory is

</summary><p>When <code>PEM_USER_KRB_INCLUDE_REALM</code> is <code>False</code>, the realm is now stripped

retained as the email so user validation succeeds.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby alert row expansion could collapse or jump to the
wrong row when the underlying data refreshed.
</summary><p>Row expansion is now bound to row identity rather than display position.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed an issue whereby new server registrations could produce a template

<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed the Dashboard tab restore path so that, after a browser refresh,
the correct content is shown for each restored tab.
</summary><p>Previously a restored tab could show the content from a different tab.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>Fixed <code>settings.get_tool_data</code> returning HTTP 404 for dashboard tabs,

<tr><td>Fixed the Auto Create toggle not appearing on Server-level and

index.
</summary><p>Probe lookup is now keyed on column name instead of position.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Preserved job-step run history when a step is removed from a job.
</summary><p>Deleted steps are now parked (marked as removed and disabled) so they
disappear from the UI, while the job step log history survives for audit
and troubleshooting.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed schedule exceptions not appearing in the job dialog.
</summary><p>The server sends exceptions as three arrays; these are now correctly
converted for display when a job's properties are loaded, not only when

<tr><td>Fixed an issue whereby the <code>os_info</code> probe incorrectly populated <code>os_start_time</code> with a 12-hour based timestamp value.</td><td></td></tr>

</details></td></tr>
